hooks.command:
[ -f graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md ] && python3 -c "
import json, re
with open('graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()
keep = [l for l in lines if not re.match(r'- \[\[_COMMUNITY_Community \d+\|Community \d+\]\]', l)]
content = ''.join(keep[:130])
print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'SessionStart', 'additionalContext': 'GRAPHIFY MAP (auto-loaded):\n' + content}}))
" || true

CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: graph loaded at session start. Prefer graphify query/path/explain over grep for cross-file questions."}}'   || true ;; esac

[ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: graph loaded at session start. Prefer graphify query/path/explain over file search for cross-file/relationship questions."}}' || true

FILE=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$FILE" in *graphify-out*|*CLAUDE.md*|*node_modules*) true ;; *src/*|*components/*|*app/*|*lib/*|*docs/*)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: reading source file — check GRAPH_REPORT.md god nodes/communities first if exploring unfamiliar code."}}' || true ;; esac
